verdict.rationale: Together's serverless docs say developers can call 100+ open-source models on shared serverless endpoints with per-token pricing and no provisioning latency, across chat, image, audio and embedding through one API. A structured model lifecycle and upgrade policy suggests the catalog is kept current. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the named families (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS) are available serverless (only Llama-2-70B appears, in a community comment), and an actual catalog listing or independent corroboration of breadth and currency.
